title: Financial Planning & Analysis Specialist
job_description:
MAIN PURPOSE

The FP&A Specialist plays a key role in supporting the financial health of the organization through financial planning, analysis, reporting, and cash flow monitoring.

The role works closely with cross-functional teams to support business performance, enhance decision-making, and ensure financial discipline, while operating under the direction of the Business Controller. In addition, the role provides support in treasury-related activities, including payment processing, in line with internal control requirements.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Financial Planning, Analysis & Reporting
Support preparation of budgets, forecasts (including Latest Estimate), and financial plans in line with internal and regional timelines.
Perform variance analysis against budget, forecast, and prior year, and highlight key drivers and risks.
Prepare and maintain financial reports and dashboards, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and timely submission.
Monitor key financial metrics including revenue, profitability, working capital, and cash flow.
Business & Commercial Support
Provide financial analysis on business performance, including product, channel, and customer profitability.
Support evaluation of pricing, promotions, and other commercial initiatives.
Work closely with stakeholders to ensure financial implications are clearly understood and aligned with business objectives.
Budget Control & Financial Discipline
Support budget monitoring and highlight risks and opportunities against plan.
Assist in identifying cost optimization opportunities and tracking implementation.
Ensure proper financial tracking and adherence to internal policies and guidelines.
Cash Flow & Treasury Support
Support cash flow monitoring and projection to ensure visibility on liquidity position.
Assist in treasury-related activities, including payment processing and coordination with relevant stakeholders.
Ensure all activities are performed in compliance with internal controls and segregation of duties.
Process Improvement & Systems
Contribute to improving financial processes, reporting efficiency, and data accuracy.
Support automation initiatives and effective use of systems (e.g., SAP, reporting tools).
Maintain data integrity and support continuous improvement in FP&A practices.

REQUIREMENTS

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related field (MBA or professional certifications like CMA, CA, ACCA is a plus).
2–3 years of experience in FP&A or related finance roles, preferably in retail, FMCG, or distribution industries.
Strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, and basic cash flow management.
Good understanding of financial metrics including profitability and working capital.
Advanced Excel skills and familiarity with ERP systems (e.g., SAP).
Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI) is an advantage.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Detail-oriented, proactive, and able to work under pressure.
Good interpersonal skills and ability to work collaboratively across functions.

title: SAP S/4HANA Technical Architect
job_description:
Seeking a highly skilled SAP Technical Architect to lead the technical architecture, design, and

implementation of SAP S/4HANA RISE solutions within a complex and fast-paced retail

environment. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in SAP S/4HANA technical

architecture, ABAP development, SAP BTP extensibility, and cloud-native integrations with AWS,

alongside a firm grasp of SAP Clean Core principles. This role will play a critical part in guiding cross

functional technical teams and ensuring delivery of reliable, scalable, and future-ready SAP solutions

across our retail ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities:

• Own the end-to-end technical design and architecture for SAP S/4HANA RISE projects, with

a focus on retail-specific use cases and cloud readiness.

• Drive the implementation of SAP Clean Core strategy, leveraging SAP BTP, embedded

Steampunk, and side-by-side extensibility while avoiding core modifications.

• Lead development and integration workstreams across SAP Retail, SAP CAR, and other

modules using modern ABAP (ABAP on HANA) and Fiori/UI5 technologies.

• Enable SAP Fiori adoption, including app extensibility, launchpad configuration, and UX

personalization for retail users.

• Coordinate integration with native AWS services (S3, SQS, Lambda, etc.) using AWS ABAP

SDK and secure API patterns.

• Support the execution of the Bluefield™ migration approach, ensuring modular

transformation while activating new S/4HANA innovations.

• Oversee technical delivery and development governance, ensuring compliance with coding

standards, performance benchmarks, and deployment best practices.

• Collaborate with functional leads, solution architects, and external partners to ensure

technical alignment and feasibility.

• Manage and mentor technical development teams across onshore/offshore delivery

models, driving consistency and quality.

• Ensure proper configuration of middleware, APIs, and DevOps tools to streamline CI/CD

pipelines and support agile delivery.

• Prepare and review technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and integration

specifications.

• Support all delivery phases including Fit-to-Standard workshops, SIT/UAT, cutover planning,

and hypercare.

Key Skills and Qualifications:

• Minimum of 2 full lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementations, including projects in the retail

industry and at least one hosted on SAP S/4HANA RISE.

• Strong technical expertise in SAP S/4HANA architecture, including ABAP (on HANA),

Fiori/UI5, CDS Views, BAPIs, and OData services.

• Experience working with SAP CAR, F&R, and other retail-specific SAP solutions.

• Practical experience integrating SAP with AWS services using AWS ABAP SDK, REST APIs, and

secure authentication.

• Hands-on experience with SAP BTP, in-app extensibility, and embedded Steampunk for

side-by-side extensions.

• Exposure to DevOps tools such as Git, Jenkins, JIRA, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.

• Strong understanding of middleware technologies (e.g., SAP PI/PO, SAP Integration Suite, or

similar).

• Excellent technical documentation, architecture design, and stakeholder communication

skills.

• Proven track record managing technical teams and collaborating across global delivery

models.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field;

SAP technical certifications are preferred.

This is not a classic assistant role.

This position is for people who want to grow into management and are comfortable working at a fast pace.

In our company:

there are many tasks from different areas

there are not always ready solutions

you need to quickly understand situations and make decisions

If you prefer a slow pace, clear instructions, and a narrow area of responsibility, this role will probably not be suitable.

coordinate managers and teams across different areas

monitor task execution, deadlines, and results

prioritize tasks within the team

participate in managing lead generation, sales, and operational processes

analytics: collect, structure, and interpret data

identify problems and bottlenecks in processes

participate in implementing tools (including AI tools)

Work distribution:
≈ 50% operational tasks
≈ 30% analytics
≈ 20% communication




Who we are looking for

For us, mindset is more important than experience.

A good candidate is someone who:

thinks quickly and learns fast

is not afraid of complex tasks and uncertainty

follows the principle “I will figure it out and get it done”

can manage several directions at the same time

completes tasks and delivers results

Requirements

working level of English

confident work with Excel / Google Sheets

willingness to use AI tools in daily work




This role may not be suitable if

you expect detailed instructions for every task

you find it difficult to work with multiple tasks at the same time

you are not ready to learn quickly

stability is more important for you than growth




Growth opportunities

This is a starting management position.

The previous person in this role grew to become the Executive Director of the project.

We plan to hire 2–3 people, with the goal of quickly developing:

1 Regional Manager (Indonesia or the next country)

the others into coordinators or team leads

Possible career paths:

Regional Manager

Functional Manager (lead generation / sales / purchasing / operations)

New region coordinator




Conditions

Start salary: $800–1000

Growth: up to $1200–1500–2000+ based on results (linked to the company’s financial KPIs)

work directly with the owner and Executive Director

high workload and fast working pace

opportunity for rapid growth based on results

international team




How to apply

In your application, please answer:

Why are you interested in fast career growth?

Give an example of a situation where you independently solved a complex problem and achieved a result.

Why did you decide to apply for this position, and why do you think you are a good fit?

Test Task: after you apply, you will receive a short task where you need to quickly understand a new topic, structure the information, and suggest possible solutions. We evaluate your speed of thinking, ability to learn, and the quality of the final result.

We’re looking for a Business Operations & Management Associate who can sit in the middle of numbers, processes, and people.

Familiarity with CRM platforms, reporting tools, or basic BI tools is a plus.




This role is for you if:

You enjoy being the person who makes sure things actually get done, not just someone watching from the sidelines.

You like mixing numbers + structure + coordination in your daily work.

You want a role where you get exposure to management decisions, while still being hands-on in operations.

You get satisfaction from turning chaos into something that’s tracked, measurable, and under control.

title: Business Analyst

Empower institutions to guide their beneficiaries toward meaningful employment opportunities through AI-driven solutions

About the Role
As a Business Analyst, you will play a key role in designing and shaping end-to-end SaaS solutions for Kinobi’s clients. This role bridges business requirements and technical execution — ensuring proposed solutions are commercially viable, functionally clear, and technically feasible.
You will work closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Implementation teams across pre-sales and early delivery phases. While grounded in strong business analysis fundamentals, this role also involves contributing to high-level solution architecture and supporting technical solution decisions.
This position is ideal for candidates with Business Analyst, Pre-Sales, or Technical Consulting backgrounds who want to deepen their exposure to solution architecture in a SaaS environment.

Responsibilities

Solution Architecture & Technical Ownership

Design and define high-level solution architectures, including system components, integrations, data flows, and deployment models.

Gather, analyze, and validate client business, functional, and technical requirements, including non-functional requirements such as scalability, security, performance, and reliability.

Assess technical feasibility, risks, and constraints of proposed solutions, and recommend architectural approaches and mitigation strategies.

Act as the technical authority during pre-sales and solutioning, ensuring solutions align with product capabilities and implementation realities.

Functional Solutioning & Delivery Readiness

Translate solution architectures into clear functional scopes, assumptions, and constraints to support smooth handover from pre-sales to implementation

Guide proof-of-concepts (POCs) and demos, ensuring functional workflows and technical designs accurately reflect real-world use cases.

Collaborate closely with Product Managers and Implementation teams to ensure solutions are deliverable, scalable, and operationally sound.

Support audit and compliance requirements (e.g., ISO 27001, IMDA) by aligning solution designs with required security and regulatory standards.

Commercial & Operational Support

Support proposal development and RFP responses by contributing architectural inputs, functional solution narratives, and technical justifications.

Maintain clear and structured solution documentation to support internal alignment and execution.

Provide insights and feedback to improve solution effectiveness, proposal success, and client satisfaction.

Conduct structured follow-ups and engagements with potential clients to clarify business, functional, and technical requirements, validate solution assumptions, and refine solution scope throughout the pre-sales and solutioning process.

Requirements

1-3 years of experience in SaaS, solution architecture, pre-sales engineering, technical consulting, or solution-focused roles.

Strong understanding of SaaS platforms, system architecture concepts, and integration patterns.

Experience gathering and translating business, functional, and technical requirements into viable solution designs.

Ability to reason about non-functional requirements such as scalability, security, performance, and reliability.

Comfortable balancing technical design with functional and operational considerations.

Strong English communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Comfortable working closely with cross-functional teams (Sales, Product, Implementation).

Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple solution streams in parallel.

Familiarity with AI-enabled solutions, data platforms, or process automation is a plus.

Exposure to RFPs, client-facing solutioning, or enterprise delivery environments preferred.

Self-driven, proactive, and motivated to grow in both technical depth and operational impact.

Why Join Us?

Work on a meaningful AI-powered product that’s transforming the future of education and impacting millions of students across Southeast Asia and beyond.

Be part of a fast-growing company with founders who deeply care about your professional and personal growth — and who are committed to building with purpose and intelligence.

Get ownership and flexibility to shape how the tech + AI team grows and scales — from roadmap to architectural decisions.

All interviews and communication will be conducted in English.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Bertanggung jawab atas fungsi analitik dengan merancang strategi pelacakan (tracking), membangun kerangka pengukuran (measurement framework), serta memberikan insight yang jelas terkait aktivitas operasional dan marketing.

Mendukung pelaksanaan A/B testing dan desain eksperimen, memastikan setiap project dapat diukur dengan baik dan hasilnya valid secara statistik.

Bekerja lintas tim (Operations, Marketing, Finance, Product) untuk memastikan setiap strategi didukung oleh data yang solid.

title: Associate Product Manager - Subs Growth and Lifecycle

The Economist Group is the leading source of analysis on international business and world affairs. We deliver world-class, thought-provoking content through a range of formats, from web and app to print, conferences, film, and audio. What ties us together is the objectivity of our opinion, the originality of our insight, and our advocacy of economic and political freedom around the world.

As our digital subscription business grows, so does the importance of delivering thoughtful, frictionless, and value-driven experiences across the entire subscriber lifecycle.

About the role

We are seeking a motivated Associate Product Manager to join our Subscriber Growth & Lifecycle product pillar. In this role, you will support the continuous improvement of subscription journeys that maximise subscriber lifetime value and foster long-term loyalty across web and app.

This is a hands-on role with strong exposure to strategy and delivery. You will contribute to initiatives across retention, upgrades, and customer care, working closely with experienced product managers, engineers, analysts, marketers, and customer operations teams. It offers a valuable opportunity to develop deep expertise in subscription products, monetisation, and experimentation within a globally recognised media organisation.

What you’ll do

As the Associate Product Manager for Subscriber Growth & Lifecycle, you will be responsible for the following with support from more senior Product Managers:

Own and optimise the end-to-end subscriber journey: You will be the product manager for key in-life subscription experiences, including upgrades, downgrades, cancellations, and re-engagement flows. You will continuously identify and address friction points, and champion a subscriber-first mindset in everything you do.

Drive monetisation and experimentation: You will develop and execute a roadmap of monetisation initiatives, including offers, add-ons, and subscription tiers. You will design and run experiments to optimise our upgrade and retention paywalls, and use data to inform our pricing and packaging strategies.

Innovate in customer care: You will partner with our Customer Care teams to redefine how we serve our subscribers. You will lead the development of our self-service and assisted service journeys, including implementing AI-powered bots and other automation technologies to improve efficiency and customer satisfaction.

Champion a data-driven culture: You will define and analyse key metrics such as churn, upgrades, engagement, and customer satisfaction. You will use this data to measure the impact of your initiatives, identify new opportunities, and communicate your progress to stakeholders.

Lead with influence: You will write clear and compelling user stories, acceptance criteria, and product documentation. You will use your strong communication and collaboration skills to align your team and stakeholders around a shared vision and roadmap.

What you’ll bring

We are looking for a candidate who is passionate about building great products and eager to learn and grow. The ideal candidate will have:

A proven track record of driving results: You have at least 2 years of experience in product management or a similar role (such as Product Marketing or Product Analytics) with a focus on digital customer journeys. You can point to specific examples of how you have used offers, discounts, add-ons, or subscription tiers to achieve business goals.

A deep understanding of the subscriber lifecycle: You have experience with paywall campaigns, experiments, or launches across web and app. You are familiar with the key levers for driving subscriber engagement, retention, and lifetime value.

A strategic and analytical mindset: You are comfortable working in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment with shifting priorities. You have a structured, data-informed approach to problem-solving and prioritisation. You are proficient in using data to make decisions and measure success.

Exceptional collaboration and communication skills: You are a natural collaborator who can work effectively with designers, engineers, analysts, and operational teams. You can articulate your ideas clearly and persuasively, and you are a great listener.

A "go-getter" mindset with high autonomy: You are a self-starter who takes initiative and can run with things independently. While you will have support from senior PMs, you are comfortable taking the lead on projects, navigating ambiguity, and proactively pushing initiatives to completion.

title: Odoo Application Support & Product Specialist
job_description:
We are looking for an analytical and problem-solving Odoo Application Support Specialist to ensure the smooth day-to-day operation of our Odoo ERP system. In this role, you will act as the primary point of escalation for all Odoo-related issues. You need to deeply understand how standard business processes (Sales, Inventory, Accounting, etc.) map to Odoo's functionalities. Your main objective is to assist in troubleshooting Odoo's issues from issue documentation and identification, help analyze and assist in resolving user inquiries at first hand, investigate data anomalies, and ensure business continuity without always relying on the core development team. Furthermore, you will act as the primary owner for scoping, exploring, and managing any new technical functionalities or third-party integrations (such as AI agents or Claude AI) to expand and enhance the Odoo ecosystem.




Key Responsibilities

1. Issue Resolution & Troubleshooting:

- Act as the Level 1 technical and functional support for all Odoo ERP users across departments.

- Identify, analyze, investigate, and assist in resolving system issues or workflow bottlenecks reported by users.

- Read and analyze system logs or error tracebacks to determine if an issue is a user error, a configuration issue, or a technical bug.




2. Business Process & Functional Support:

- Guide and educate end-users on the correct way to utilize Odoo features according to the company's Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

- Assist user in performing data corrections and adjustments within Odoo safely (e.g., fixing stuck inventory moves, correcting journal entries).

- Identify recurring user issues and propose process improvements or create Knowledge Base articles/FAQs to reduce future support tickets.




3. Technical support Escalation & Collaboration:

- Filter and validate technical bugs before escalating them to the Odoo Development/Technical team.

- Provide clear, reproducible steps and context to developers to speed up the bug-fixing process.

- Assist in testing bug fixes and patches deployed by developers in a staging environment before they are released to production.




4. System Enhancement & New Integrations:

- Act as the primary owner and project lead for any new technical functionalities to be built or integrated with Odoo.

- Research, scope, and manage third-party integrations, including exploring emerging technologies like AI agents (e.g., Claude AI integration).

- Bridge the gap between business needs and technical execution for system expansions, ensuring new integrations align with existing Odoo architecture.




Job Requirements

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, IT, or a related field.

- Experience: 1–3 years of experience providing application support or working as a Functional Consultant specifically for Odoo ERP.

- Strong understanding of core Odoo modules (e.g., Inventory, Sales, Purchase, Accounting) and how they interact with one another.

- Ability to quickly understand diverse business workflows and translate user complaints into systemic Odoo functions.

- Ability to read and understand Python error logs and tracebacks.

- Basic to intermediate knowledge to query data during investigations.

- Understanding of Odoo's technical settings.

- Strong interest or basic knowledge in system integrations, RESTful APIs, and connecting third-party applications to Odoo.

- Forward-thinking mindset with an eagerness to explore and implement new technologies (such as AI tools) into existing ERP workflows.

- Project management mindset with the ability to take ownership of new system features from exploration to deployment.

About The Role: 

Responsible for supporting the implementation of the Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework through the collection, analysis, validation, and reporting of risk data across all company units.

This role focuses on the development of the risk reporting system, management of the risk register, preparation of Key Risk Indicators (KRI), and strengthening of risk governance in accordance with regulatory requirements (Bank Indonesia) and internal company policies. The position plays a role in maintaining the integrity of risk data, ensuring the effectiveness of internal controls, and supporting risk-based decision making.

What Will You Do: 

Collect, validate, and analyze risk data across business and operations, including trend analysis, loss events, incident reports, and control effectiveness using quantitative and qualitative methods.

Develop and maintain data-driven risk dashboards and reports to monitor KRI, EWI, and risk appetite metrics, and present insights to ERM Manager, Risk Committee, and regulators.

Maintain and update the company’s risk governance documentation, including risk registers, control libraries, committee minutes, action items, and follow-up tracking to ensure alignment with internal risk policies.

Support Risk Management Committee activities and regulatory governance by preparing complete, accurate quarterly and annual risk reports while enforcing compliance with internal risk documentation standards.

Support enterprise-wide risk identification and assessment while coordinating mitigation actions with relevant units to ensure timely completion of risk treatment plans.

Promote internal risk awareness and data-driven risk management practices to strengthen a strong risk governance culture across all operational areas.

What we are looking for: 

Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Management, Finance, Law, Statistics, Mathematics, or Information Technology (Information Systems).

Minimum 3–5 years of experience in risk analytics, governance, audit, compliance, or data risk management within Payment Gateway / Fintech / Banking / Financial Institutions.

Strong understanding of Enterprise Risk Management concepts, COSO/ISO 31000, and risk scoring methodology.

Technical Competency Requirements :

Strong proficiency in advanced Excel (pivot, lookup, automation).

Understanding of risk taxonomy, KRI development, control testing, and incident analysis.

Ability to perform data validation and data interpretation to support accurate risk reporting.

Basic understanding of internal risk management systems or applications.

Ability to conduct trend analysis and scenario-based risk evaluation

Soft Competency Requirements :

Leadership: Leading cross-functional teams in identifying and mitigating risks.

Analytical Thinking: Able to transform complex data into strategic insights.

Communication: Clearly presenting risk analysis results to management and regulators.

Problem Solving: Identifying root causes of risks and defining effective mitigation actions.

1. Melakukan need assessment terhadap individu, sekolah, perguruan tinggi, maupun perusahaan untuk mengidentifikasi gap kompetensi, potensi, dan tantangan organisasi.

• Training soft skill (Leadership, Communication, Achievement Motivation,
Team Building, dll.)
• Program pengembangan manajerial
• Coaching & Counseling for Leader
• Asesmen psikologis (bakat, minat, kepribadian, rekrutmen, promosi jabatan)

3. Menyusun strategi pemasaran produk training dan asesmen.
4. Membangun dan menjaga relasi dengan klien melalui pendekatan konsultatif.
5. Melakukan presentasi produk dan solusi kepada calon klien (online maupun offline).
6. Mengelola pipeline penjualan dari prospek hingga closing.
7. Menyusun penawaran harga dan melakukan negosiasi kerja sama.
8. Bekerja sama dengan tim digital marketing untuk:
• Penyusunan konten promosi
• Campaign awareness
• Lead generation
9. Mengelola database klien dan melakukan follow-up berkala.
10. Mencapai target penjualan dan pertumbuhan bisnis yang telah ditetapkan.
11. Membuat laporan perkembangan bisnis dan analisis performa penjualan.
12. Mengembangkan strategi retensi klien dan repeat order.

Pendidikan & Latar Belakang
• Minimal D4 atau S1 semua jurusan.
• Memiliki pemahaman tentang konsep dasar pengembangan bisnis, marketing, manajemen, dan SDM, training, dan/atau asesmen psikologi menjadi nilai tambah.

• Memahami proses penjualan B2B (Business to Business) dan siklus closing.
• Mampu melakukan presentasi profesional kepada klien.
• Terbiasa menggunakan tools seperti Microsoft Office/Google Workspace (terutama Word, Excel, dan PowerPoint)
• Memahami strategi dasar digital marketing dan proses akuisisi pelanggan baru menjadi nilai tambah.

title: Lending Risk Analyst Acceleration Program
job_description:
About the Role

GoTo Financial is seeking ambitious talents to join our Lending Risk Analyst Acceleration Program. This is not just a job, it is a structured rotational program designed to build the next generation of risk leaders in the digital finance space—offering a faster track to career progression for high-potential individuals.

As a trainee, you will embark on a hands-on on-the-job learning journey, rotating through specialized functions within our Lending Risk division. You will gain deep expertise in identifying, assessing, and mitigating the most critical risks in our financial ecosystems. By working alongside industry experts, you will learn how to balance innovation with prudence while accelerating your professional growth in one of Southeast Asia's fastest-growing fintech environments.

Your work will help reshaping the future of thelending industry. If you’re excited about the challenge, this role is for you!”

What You Will Do

Risk Analytics & Insights: Leverage large datasets to extract actionable insights, identify emerging risk trends, monitor portfolio performance, and support the development of data-driven risk strategies across credit and fraud domains.
Rotational Exposure: Participate in structured rotations across different functions within Credit Risk and Fraud Risk to understand the end-to-end risk management lifecycle.
Risk Monitoring: Support the team in daily risk monitoring activities, including tracking key risk indicators (KRIs) and generating regular risk reports for stakeholders.
Policy & Process Improvement: Collaborate with team leads to review and enhance risk policies, standard operating procedures, and internal controls to ensure they remain robust and scalable.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with STLs, Finance, Product, and Engineering teams to ensure risk considerations are integrated into new product launches and features.
Project Support: Contribute to special projects and initiatives aimed at modernizing the risk management framework, including the exploration of new tools or methodologies.


What You Will Need:

Educational Background: Fresh graduate or recent graduate (graduated within the last 2 years) with a Bachelor's or Master's degree from a reputable university.
Field of Study: Strong academic track record in Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, Finance, or other related quantitative fields.
Data Proficiency: Analytical skills with hands-on experience in data analysis tools (e.g., Excel, SQL, Python, or R) is highly preferred.
Problem-Solving Mindset: Logical thinking and structured problem-solving skills with a passion for data analysis and tackling complex challenges.
Adaptability: Eagerness to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges in a fast-paced, ever-changing fintech landscape.
Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; ability to articulate complex ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
Attitude: Highly motivated, detail-oriented, and possessing a strong sense of integrity and ownership.



About the Team

You will be part of the GoPay Lending Risk Team, responsible for supporting the risk management of our lending products. The team plays a key role in ensuring that our lending business grows sustainably while maintaining strong risk control.

The team focuses on identifying, assessing, and managing credit and operational risks across the lending lifecycle, including risk strategy, policy development, monitoring portfolio performance, and implementing risk mitigation measures.

You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Data, Engineering, and Business teams, and collaborate with stakeholders across different regions. This provides an opportunity to contribute to impactful initiatives while gaining exposure to a dynamic and fast-growing fintech environment.

About GoTo Group

GoTo is the largest digital ecosystem in Indonesia. GoTo's mission is to 'empower progress' by offering technology infrastructure and solutions that help everyone to access and thrive in the digital economy.

The GoTo ecosystem provides a wide range of services, including mobility, delivery, payments, financial services, and technology solutions for merchants. The ecosystem also provides e-commerce services through Tokopedia and banking services through its partnership with Bank Jago.

About Gojek 

Gojek is Southeast Asia’s leading on-demand platform and pioneer of the multi-service ecosystem with over 2.5 million driver partners across the regions offering a wide range of services such as transportation, food delivery, logistics and more. With its mission to create impact at scale, Gojek is committed to resolving consumer problems and raising standards of living by connecting consumers to the best providers of goods and services in the market.

About GoTo Financial

GoTo Financial accelerates financial inclusion through its leading financial services and merchants solutions. Its consumer services include GoPay and GoPayLater and serve businesses of all sizes through Midtrans, Moka, GoBiz Plus, GoBiz, and Selly. With its trusted and inclusive ecosystem of products, GoTo Financial is open to new growth opportunities and aims to empower everyone to Make It Happen, Make It Together, Make It Last.
